verses.text: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
lines: “How have you helped him who is without power!
How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

verses.text: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
lines: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom,
and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

verses.text: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
lines: To whom have you uttered words?
Whose spirit came out of you?

verses.text: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
lines: “The departed spirits tremble,
those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

verses.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
lines: Sheol is naked before God,
and Abaddon has no covering.

verses.text: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
lines: He stretches out the north over empty space,
and hangs the earth on nothing.

verses.text: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
lines: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds,
and the cloud is not burst under them.

verses.text: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
lines: He encloses the face of his throne,
and spreads his cloud on it.

verses.text: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
lines: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters,
and to the confines of light and darkness.

verses.text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
lines: The pillars of heaven tremble
and are astonished at his rebuke.

verses.text: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
lines: He stirs up the sea with his power,
and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

verses.text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
lines: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished.
His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

verses.text: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
lines: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways.
How small a whisper do we hear of him!
But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
